title: drymophloeus oninensis
intro: Drymophloeus oninensis, commonly known as the Onin palm, is a species of palm tree native to tropical forests in Southeast Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Onin palm are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce pain and fever. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
